name: Adept AkashicAOS
plain: Single curve: power-warped ramp plus sine bump, renormalised, and a limit on how much one step can shrink.
math:
u'=u^.85+.08·sin(πu)(1−u/2); normalised. Ratio guard: σ_{i−1}/σ_i ≤ 1.5.
Unless noted: σ_max ≤ 1 uses σ=σmax+u(σmin−σmax); otherwise Karras mapping with ρ=7 and u as ramp. Then 0.

props.shape: ramp warp mapped through Karras or linear

label: from code
surprise: The 1.5 ratio cap overrides the requested endpoint, so at low step counts the schedule never reaches σmin before the jump to 0 (adept_schedulers.py:119-121).
